about: Product Hunt (producthunt.com), a site where new tech products launch daily. This CLI reads Product Hunt's public Atom feed of the latest featured launches, optionally filtered by topic, and returns each launch's post id, launch date, product name, tagline, product page URL and author.

commands.summary: List the latest featured Product Hunt launches, newest first, optionally filtered by topic slug. Each entry has the post id, launch date, product name, tagline, product page URL and author.

params.name: category
params.description: Topic slug to filter launches by, as it appears in Product Hunt topic URLs (lowercase, hyphenated), e.g. productivity, developer-tools, artificial-intelligence. Omit to get all featured launches.
